bug_fixed.description: Orange badge was not appearing on Cuentas Banco because fetchPendingDeposits was not being called due to React closure issue
bug_fixed.root_cause: The useCallback for fetchPendingDeposits had dependencies on [token, user], but when the useEffect ran initially, the user object was null/undefined. The callback was being skipped because of the early return check: `if (!token || !user || !['super_admin', 'admin'].includes(user.role)) return;`
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Split the single useEffect into two: one for general fetches (fetchSummary, fetchUnreadCount) and a separate effect for fetchPendingDeposits that only runs when user is available and has the correct role
